title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 0.1 Test 5
summary: Test 5 is an unsigned build of the portable green Mouse Without Borders fork. Download `MouseWithoutBorders.exe` from Assets and use this same release on every computer.
changes: Fixes clipped text on the first-run welcome screen and the Portable settings tab.
Groups Start with Windows and Create a desktop shortcut as installation-only options.
Makes the preferences-file explanations clearer and fully visible.
Rewrites About to explain this portable edition first while preserving the original creator and complete contributor credits.
Uses the green classic icon consistently in About and other runtime windows.
Rebuilds the 16, 20, and 24 pixel EXE icon frames from the original classic artwork so Windows small-icon views render cleanly.
testing: At your normal Windows display scaling, start with no prefs file and confirm the welcome screen has no clipped or overlapping text.
Confirm Start with Windows and Create a desktop shortcut are clearly marked as options used only when installing.
Run portably, open Settings > Portable, and confirm all descriptions are fully visible.
Open About and confirm its icon is green, the portable-edition explanation comes first, and the original creator and complete contributor list remain visible below.
View MouseWithoutBorders.exe with Windows Explorer set to small icons and confirm the green icon is crisp rather than garbled.
Use this same Test 5 EXE on both computers and test mouse, keyboard, clipboard, file transfer, reconnect, firewall prompting, and sleep/wake.
